name: Lighthouse Gold Inc.
summary: Alerio Gold Corp. operates as a mineral exploration and development firm, actively engaged in acquiring, investigating, and advancing natural resource properties across South America. The company holds complete ownership of two gold assets situated in Guyana. Its primary holding is the Tassawini property, an expansive 3,413-acre site located to the northwest of Georgetown, Guyana. Alerio Gold Corp. has its corporate base in Vancouver, Canada.
